needs.what: admit the per-turn life-gain ledger value {"life_gained_this_turn": "you"} into STATIC_VALUE_KEYS, so a static's condition can say "if you gained life this turn" as {"cmp": ">", "left": {"life_gained_this_turn": "you"}, "right": {"const": 0}} -- here on the card's own cast_from_graveyard static with active_zones ["graveyard"] and affects_player "you" (the Gravecrawler shape)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_graveyard with active_zones ["graveyard"] carries the card's own permission and takes a static condition, but the static condition language's cmp may only read static_value_keys, which has cards_drawn_this_turn, creatures_died_this_turn and spells_cast_this_turn but not life_gained_this_turn; that value exists only for effect-side conditions (trigger intervening-ifs). graveyard_cost is an unconditional alternative price, and flashback/retrace are different permissions.
